title: Illustration use / Four numbered topics

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Make sequence explicit so viewers can distinguish and remember several related topics.
strategic_value: Numbered circles beneath expressive figures can let Helsinki organize information without abandoning its illustration voice.
demonstration: Four character groups run across an orange page above four green circles containing numbered placeholder labels; a small heading sits at upper left.
practical_value: Use a repeated numbered shape to anchor a row of illustrated topics.

content_islands.name: Section heading
content_islands.spec: Place the small white heading above the illustrated row.

content_islands.name: Four topic units
content_islands.spec: Align each character group with one green numbered circle beneath it.

ingredient.name: Numbered topic circles
ingredient.role: Make the order of related topics visible.
ingredient.application: Align each illustration with a repeated numbered label.
ingredient.scope: Observed four-topic layout; the page does not establish a required circle size or item count.

reference_purposes.Application: The page organizes four illustrated topics with numbers and matching circular labels.
reference_purposes.Expression: Orange and green fields frame varied people through a repeated geometry.
